story.title: Built for how your customers actually buy
story.lead: Most store builders were made for card payments and English. Your customers pay in cash, ask questions on WhatsApp and read right to left. OffOnSale starts there.

items.title: Cash on delivery, without the fake orders
items.body: Every cash-on-delivery order is checked before it ships: repeat refusals, risky cities, too many orders from one network. Ask risky buyers to confirm on WhatsApp or pay a small advance, automatically.

items.title: Your customers already live on WhatsApp
items.body: Order confirmations, cart recovery and help buttons go where your buyers are. One tap to confirm a COD order, one tap to ask you a question.

items.title: Urdu, Arabic and English, properly
items.body: Right-to-left from the first pixel, not a mirrored afterthought. Your store, checkout and emails in each language, with your own words for each.

items.title: Your customers' addresses, locked
items.body: Phone numbers and addresses are encrypted in the shopper's browser. Only your team can open them. Not us, not anyone who breaks in.

items.title: A checkout that is yours
items.body: Your logo, colours, trust badges, delivery promises and your own questions. Rules that hide COD for far cities or add a fee. Offers after the order that still pay on delivery.

bento.title: Run your whole store from one beautiful admin

theme.title: Design without code
theme.body: Click anything on your store to edit it. Drag in banners, columns and videos with the visual designer.

checkout.title: Custom checkout
checkout.body: Branding, blocks, extra fields, rules and upsells, with a live preview.

returns.title: Returns & exchanges
returns.body: Shoppers ask for a size swap from their order page. You approve, restock and settle in a click.

discounts.title: Discounts & gift cards
discounts.body: Codes, automatic sales, buy-X-get-Y and gift cards that work at checkout.

accounts.title: Customer accounts with passkeys
accounts.body: Shoppers sign in with their fingerprint or face. No passwords to forget.

items.q: Do I need a card to start?
items.a: No. Your 14-day trial needs no card. Add one anytime during the trial so your plan starts by itself. Without a card, your store closes to shoppers 7 days after the trial ends, until a plan is paid. Your products and orders are never deleted.

items.q: How do I pay for my plan?
items.a: By card, charged automatically each month, or by bank transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa against an invoice. Prices are in Pakistani rupees.

items.q: Does OffOnSale see my customers' details?
items.a: No. Phone numbers and addresses are encrypted in the shopper's browser with a key only your team holds. Your card is saved by our payment partner: OffOnSale never sees its number.
Anytime. Upgrades take effect straight away and you pay only the difference for the rest of the month. Downgrades start at your next renewal.

items.q: Can my store be in Urdu or Arabic?
items.a: Yes. Your store, checkout and order pages work in Urdu, Arabic and English, right to left where it should be, and shoppers switch languages in one tap.

items.q: I already sell on Shopify. Can I move?
items.a: Yes. Import your products, customers and order history, then switch your domain when you are ready.

about.title: Commerce, made for here.
about.lead: OffOnSale started with a simple frustration: the tools brands in Pakistan and the Gulf use were built for somewhere else.
story: Cash on delivery is how most of our customers pay, yet every store builder treats it as an afterthought. Fake orders and refused parcels quietly eat the margins of the brands we love.
So we built a platform around how people here actually buy: COD that protects you, WhatsApp at every step, and Urdu and Arabic that feel native, not translated.
And because trust matters, we encrypt your customers' details in their own browser. We built OffOnSale so that even we cannot read them.

values.title: Local first
values.body: Rupees, cash on delivery, WhatsApp and right-to-left are the starting point, not add-ons.

values.title: Privacy by design
values.body: Your customers' addresses are yours. Encrypted end to end, readable only by your team.

values.title: Beautiful by default
values.body: Your store should look like a brand on day one, not after hiring a designer.

values.title: Fair pricing
values.body: Clear plans in rupees, a real free trial, and no surprise fees on your sales.

privacy.p: Your account details (name, email), your store's settings and content, and invoices for your plan. Shoppers' phone numbers and addresses are encrypted in their browser and only your team can read them.
Your card is saved by our payment partner. OffOnSale keeps only a reference, the brand, the last four digits and the expiry date.
To run your store, bill your plan, keep the service secure and talk to you about your account. We never sell your data or your customers' data.
Export or delete your store's data at any time from your admin, or write to us and we will help.

terms.p: Every store starts with a 14-day free trial. No card is needed to start.
Plans are billed monthly in Pakistani rupees, by card or against an invoice. Upgrades are prorated; downgrades start at the next renewal.
If a plan is not paid, your store stays open for a 7-day grace period, then closes to shoppers until it is paid. Your data is kept.
You own your store, products and customer relationships. You are responsible for what you sell and for following local laws.
